Per-frame distinct identity sums are descriptive request dedup counts, not measured rasterizations, uploads or CPU recovery hits.
Existing budgets, adaptive caches and residency churn prevent direct conversion of unique identity reductions into memory/time savings.
The carry1/3/6 aim-6/0/6 representative proof matrix is not exhaustive for captured carry/aim combinations.
